ns2:section.sectionText: Each week students will be guided through asynchronous lecture/background materials online via course website on compass. Must be 21 years of age by the first class session. This lecture section for outside majors only. Students registered in this lecture section of FSHN 304 will be assessed a $75 class materials fee. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Info for Current Students, then Waitlist Information.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Not intended for students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
